provenance.writtenFor: DROBON AEGIS DAST cumulative gap-closure master pump (2026-10-19)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A text/html response without a charset parameter keeps the browser's legacy fallback, so it is reported even when the media type is upper-cased.

groundTruth.rationale: text/html without a charset declaration leaves decoding to a legacy default or sniffing; the media type is case-insensitive, so the upper-case form is the same declaration.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object; no body is served and no decoding is performed.
The finding states that the encoding is undeclared, not that a specific byte sequence is exploitable.
